messages:
lauren: heads-up — multiple customers reporting 502/504s and huge tail latency hitting hosted inference in eu-west2 (~az-b/az-c). First alert came in ~08:00 UTC, now wide. Customers seeing auth timeouts and retries too. txs: 9 customer tickets and a support escalation call.

ben: on it. can you drop a few request IDs and any common path / model? also are these hitting gateway or direct model endpoints?

lauren: majority are via /v1/generate (hosted API). sample trace ids: trace=tr-0a3f1c, tr-0a3f1d, tr-0a3f2a. models: gptx-open-6b and gptx-open-2b. errors from app logs: 502 gateway timeout and 504 upstream timeout. Some customers report 401 intermittently while retrying.

maria: seeing host-level retries and TCP retransmits from eu-west2-egress. Packet loss spikes between our egress and transit provider starting 07:58 UTC. quick tcpdump tails: ```07:58:12.123 IP x.x.x.x > y.y.y.y: Flags [P.], seq 1:145, ack 1, win 229
07:58:12.223 IP x.x.x.x > y.y.y.y: retransmission```

vikram: that matches infra metrics — cross-az p95 latency up ~600ms and packet loss up to 4% for short windows. Autoscaling is healthy but gateway retries amplify latency into 5xx.

ben: can we confirm route changes or BGP flaps? checking provider BGP peers now. also rolling logs from egress LB: ```EgressLB | 2026-03-14T07:58:xx | conn reset to transit-asn 64512 | error=EPIPE```

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260314-0453 — severity P1. Pager duty notified.

lauren: customer-ops asked for repro steps to validate — they want exact curl and headers used. posting a sanitized repro here.

support-joe: repro that some customers used (sanitized): ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gptx-open-6b","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate``` Observed 502 within 2s on ~30% of runs during window. Adding --retry 3 still returned 504 in some cases.

maria: quick mitigation: enable egress route duplication to alternate transit for eu-west2 for traffic to provider ASN 64512. Can push a soft route change to force path via peering2 while we engage provider. Would need oncall sign-off.

ben: agree. creating a temporary reroute. also flipping gateway fallback to use model-variant in same AZ as a stopgap (force local routing).

lauren: notified affected customers (brief): "We're investigating elevated 5xxs in eu-west2 caused by a third-party network provider. We have a mitigation in flight and will update in 15m. Apologies for the disruption." :eyes:

vikram: provider ticket opened — TP#987654. provider acknowledges intermittent micro-loss between 07:58-08:10 UTC and is investigating a flapping cross-connect at their POP.

customer-ops: customer A asked about billing — many of their requests retried and they saw token double-billing. need a list of impacted request IDs and we should flag for credit.

support-joe: gathering request IDs and will attach to the ticket. suggest issuing customer credit for retry-duplicates and marking those tokens as waived.

maria: after route switch, packet loss dropped to ~0.1% and 5xx rate decreased ~85% around 08:09 UTC. still monitoring for late errors.

ben: follow-up actions — 1) escalate to transit provider with packet captures (done), 2) create runbook entry for cross-az egress flaps, 3) customer credits and postmortem. assigning owners: ben (network), lauren (customer comms), maria (postmortem + capture stash), support-joe (billing reconciliation).

lauren: customers updated. will run retro call at 14:00 UTC. any short-term tips for customers to avoid auth 401s?

vikram: recommend short-term retry backoff with jitter and idempotency keys. also advise clients to prefer our region endpoint eu-west2.api.redwood-inference.com pinned to same AZ when possible.

incident-bot: Pager duty incident resolved by ack at 08:12 UTC (temporary mitigations). Marking as "monitoring".

lauren: leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and final customer credit list. thanks all. :thumbsup:
